PostToolUse.command: FILE="$FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.docx$'; then echo "Validating $FILE..."; python3 /mnt/skills/public/docx/scripts/office/validate.py "$FILE" && echo "✓ DOCX valid" || echo "✗ DOCX INVALID — fix before continuing"; fi

PreToolUse.command: CMD="$TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE 'DROP TABLE|TRUNCATE TABLE'; then echo '{"block": true, "message": "Destructive DDL blocked — confirm manually in Supabase dashboard"}' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE 'DELETE FROM (nai_scores|country_reports|scenario_probabilities|articles) WHERE' | grep -v 'conflict_day'; then echo '{"block": true, "message": "Mass DELETE without conflict_day filter blocked — too risky"}' >&2; exit 2; fi
